sections.text:
Item #1: After studying material, self-testing is more effective at enhancing learning than repeated studying.
Item #2: It is best to study in a consistent and uncluttered environment.
Item #3: A recent review concludes that there is no evidence to support the notion that different people benefit from different learning styles, such as visual vs auditory.
Item #4: It is better to study a topic spaced out and mixed with other topics, than all at once.
